IUI and DI are clearly separated with up to 6 cycles funded for specific indications (same-sex, physical disability, anovulatory infertility).

policies.living_children_rule: No living children from a current or any previous relationship (applies to both partners; adopted children count as biological).
policies.additional_notes: 1 cycle for women under 40. 1 cycle for women aged 40-42 provided no previous IVF, no low ovarian reserve, and cycle commences before 43rd birthday. Same-sex couples/single women must complete 6 self-funded and 6 NHS-funded IUI cycles (12 total) before IVF. Reversal of sterilisation is not funded. Single embryo transfer is standard.

policies.living_children_rule: No living children from a current or any previous relationship (applies to both partners; adopted children count as biological).
policies.additional_notes: Routinely funded for severe deficits in semen quality, or obstructive/non-obstructive azoospermia. Inherits IVF age and cycle criteria: 1 cycle max. Same-sex/single women must complete 12 IUI cycles before IVF/ICSI is considered.

policies.living_children_rule: No living children from a current or any previous relationship (applies to both partners; adopted children count as biological).
policies.additional_notes: Funded for physical/psychosexual problems, specific conditions (e.g., HIV sperm washing), and same-sex/single women. Same-sex/single women must first complete 6 self-funded IUI cycles before NHS funds a further 6 cycles. Not routinely offered for unexplained infertility, mild endometriosis, or mild male factor.

policies.living_children_rule: No living children from a current or any previous relationship (applies to both partners; adopted children count as biological).
policies.additional_notes: Considered for obstructive/non-obstructive azoospermia, severe semen deficits (if declining ICSI), high risk of genetic/infectious disease transmission, or severe rhesus isoimmunisation. Patients failing to achieve pregnancy using IUI/DI will be considered for IVF.

policies.living_children_rule: No living children from a current or any previous relationship (applies to both partners; adopted children count as biological).
policies.additional_notes: A full cycle of IVF includes the transfer of all resultant fresh and/or frozen embryos. The cycle only ends when all frozen embryos are used, a live birth occurs, or a child is adopted.
